zh: 滙豐港元穩定幣推出約一個月
RedCoin註冊用戶數量已突破10萬人
穩定幣應用拓展至支付及財富管理
work.en: HSBC's Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, RedCoin, has surpassed 100,000 users within its first month of launch. The bank is expanding its stablecoin applications across payment and wealth management use cases.
work.title: 滙豐RedCoin首月用戶破10萬穩定幣應用拓展至支付及財富管理- 數字經濟

zh: 金管局正式推出CMU數字資產平台
平台全面支持債券代幣化發行
實現無紙化及24小時多幣種結算
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) has officially launched the CMU Digital Asset Platform. The platform supports bond tokenization, lifecycle paperless operations, and 24-hour multi-currency settlement.
work.title: 金管局推出CMU數字資產平台 支持債券代幣化、24小時多幣種結算

zh: 貝萊德在香港推出代幣化貨幣市場基金
該基金正式開放接受穩定幣進行投資
推動機構級數字資產在港落地應用
work.en: BlackRock has launched a tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong that accepts stablecoin investments. The move facilitates direct integration between stablecoins and traditional yield products.
work.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized MMF in Hong Kong, Allowing Stablecoin Investment

zh: 聯交所譴責中國恒大及恒大物業
許家印及夏海鈞等7名董事遭譴責
涉及恒大物業違規向恒大提供134億資助
work.en: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange has publicly censured China Evergrande Group, Evergrande Property Services, and seven former directors, including Hui Ka Yan. The action follows severe breaches of listing rules involving 13.4 billion yuan in financial assistance transferred from the property management unit to the parent company.
work.title: 聯交所譴責中國恒大、恒大物業及7名董事

zh: 主要受人工智能電子產品需求帶動
專家預計明年出口維持雙位數增長
work.en: Hong Kong's exports surged by 65.6% year-on-year in October, driven by strong global demand for AI-related tech hardware. Analysts expect Hong Kong's total exports to maintain double-digit growth into next year.
work.title: 分析料明年AI投資仍有增長 本港出口有望維持雙位數增幅

zh: 瑞銀預計本港明年樓價總體保持平穩
住宅估值偏貴受制於約3.2厘回報
若加息致按揭成本高或現租樓好過買樓
work.en: UBS predicts Hong Kong residential property prices will remain stable next year, while transaction volume may slightly contract. The bank highlighted that mortgage costs could exceed current rental yields of 3.2% to 3.3% if prime rates rise.
work.title: 瑞銀料本港明年樓價平穩 成交略為萎縮
